children: TOKYO--Japan's Ministry of Finance said Monday it is auctioning Y250.0 billion of 10-year inflation-indexed government bonds.

Issue                   10-year CPI-indexed bond (No 3193 reopened) 
Coupon                                                         0.6% 
Settlement Date                                        Nov 17, 2026 
Maturity Date                                          Mar 10, 2036 
Offer Amount                                         Y250.0 Billion 
 
 
 
   Inflation-indexed bonds' principal is linked to changes in Japan's nationwide core consumer price index, which excludes fresh food prices. 
   Changes in the principal will lag a rise or fall in the core CPI by three months, while the coupon will stay fixed. 
   The finance ministry conducts either standard or Dutch auctions when issuing these bonds.In Dutch, or uniform - price, auctions, successful bidders pay only the price of the lowest accepted bid, rather than the price they bid, as in conventional multiple price auctions. 
   An 'N/A' for the coupon in the table above means the auction is in a Dutch format.The coupon will be announced in the afternoon.
